terra.problem: “A city of the Gibeonites” refers to the Israelites learning the Gibeonites lived nearby, which is in Joshua 9:16. Expand the passage to Joshua 9:16–17.
“A border city” calls Kiriath-jearim Baalah, but Joshua 18:14–15 does not give that name. Add Joshua 15:9 to the passage references.
“The Danites camp here” says there were six hundred Danites, but that number is in Judges 18:11, not 18:12. Expand the passage to Judges 18:11–12.
“The ark comes to Kiriath-jearim” says the Philistines sent back the ark, but the cited passage does not say this. Expand the passage to 1 Samuel 6:21–7:2.
“David brings the ark out” says David later brought the ark to his tent in Jerusalem, but 1 Chronicles 13:5–6 does not tell this. Add 2 Chronicles 1:4 to the passage references.
